name: KJ ARENA
desc:
- Halloween Event is over!
- Changed base speed and reworked dashes
- Bug fixes

This is a Beta version of the game and we hope you enjoyed every destructive attack and high-quality cinematic we have to offer! We still have a lot to finish, such as King & Slap Guy! (eh, you can get early access of both in store tab)

Thank you Paul Owen for letting us use your amazing music in our game!

👍 Thumbs up and favorite the game if you liked it!

🖥️🎮Controls:
[LMB/B2] - Melee
[1, 2, 3, 4/LB1, LB2, RB2, RB1] Moves
[F/B4] Block
[Q/B1] Dash
[G/DpadUp] Awaken
[B/DpadLeft] Emotes
[L3] Console Shift Lock
[Dpad Right] Lock On
